title: Dictation sheet and word bank
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Similar-sounding letters; the four seasons; my mother
source: Seeded from arabic/y4 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: dictation sheet and word bank)
intro: Lesson 14: Dictation: words with similar-sounding letters. To understand how careful listening helps me write words with similar-sounding letters correctly

questions.q: Write the word the teacher says: ضَوْء.
questions.model: Teacher says ضَوْء twice; 'I hear a heavy d from the side of the tongue: ض. Then وْ with sukun, then ء.' Writes it.

questions.q: Dictation on the pupil PDF: ten words and one sentence (فِي الصَّبَاحِ أَشْرَبُ الحَلِيبَ), then swap with a partner to check with the word bank.
questions.a: Ten words and the sentence spelt correctly with harakat
questions.model: Teacher dictates word 1, then shows how to check it against the word bank and tick it.

questions.q: correct three mistakes the teacher has planted in a sentence.
questions.a: Mistakes per the teacher's sheet, for example سَمَك written with ص

questions.q: write your own sentence with two heavy letters.
Back to our ponder: why is dictation harder than copying?
questions.a: You must hear, choose letters and add harakat
